module RuboCop

      # Checks that the backslash of a line continuation is separated from
      # preceding text by exactly one space (default) or zero spaces.
      #
      # @example EnforcedStyle: space (default)
      #   # bad
      #   'a'\
      #   'b'  \
      #   'c'
      #
      #   # good
      #   'a' \
      #   'b' \
      #   'c'
      #
      # @example EnforcedStyle: no_space
      #   # bad
      #   'a' \
      #   'b'  \
      #   'c'
      #
      #   # good
      #   'a'\
      #   'b'\
      #   'c'
      class LineContinuationSpacing < Base
        include RangeHelp
        include PercentLiteral
        include CommentsHelp
        extend AutoCorrector

        def on_new_investigation
          return unless processed_source.raw_source.include?('\\')

          last_line = last_line(processed_source)

          processed_source.raw_source.lines.each_with_index do |line, index|
            break if index >= last_line

            line_number = index + 1
            investigate(line, line_number)
          end
        end

        private

        def investigate(line, line_number)
          offensive_spacing = find_offensive_spacing(line)
          return unless offensive_spacing

          range = source_range(
            processed_source.buffer,
            line_number,
            line.length - offensive_spacing.length - 1,
            offensive_spacing.length
          )

          return if ignore_range?(range)

          add_offense(range) { |corrector| autocorrect(corrector, range) }
        end

        def find_offensive_spacing(line)
          if no_space_style?
            line[/\s+\\$/, 0]
          elsif space_style?
            line[/((?<!\s)|\s{2,})\\$/, 0]
          end
        end

        def message(_range)
          if no_space_style?
            'Use zero spaces in front of backslash.'
          elsif space_style?
            'Use one space in front of backslash.'
          end
        end

        def autocorrect(corrector, range)
          correction = if no_space_style?
                         '\\'
                       elsif space_style?
                         ' \\'
                       end
          corrector.replace(range, correction)
        end

        # rubocop:disable Metrics/AbcSize, Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/MethodLength, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity
        def ignored_literal_ranges(ast)
          ranges = Set.new
          source_buffer = processed_source.buffer
          comment_config = processed_source.comment_config
          source_comments = processed_source.comments

          source_comments.each do |comment|
            comment_range = comment.source_range
            next unless comment_range

            directive = RuboCop::DirectiveComment.new(comment)
            line_number = comment.loc.line
            begin_pos = comment_range.begin_pos
            end_pos = comment_range.end_pos
            comment_span = range_between(begin_pos, end_pos)
            directive_captures = directive.match_captures

            if directive_captures
              ranges << comment_span
            elsif comment_config.comment_only_line?(line_number)
              line_span = source_buffer.line_range(line_number)
              ranges << line_span
            else
              ranges << comment_range
            end
          end

          ast_location = ast.source_range
          ast_end = ast.loc.end if ast.loc.respond_to?(:end)

            nearby_comments = comments_in_range(ast)
            nearby_comments.each do |inline_comment|
              ranges << inline_comment.source_range
            end
          end

          ast.each_node(:str, :dstr, :array) do |literal|
            loc = literal.location
            next unless loc

            if loc.respond_to?(:end) && loc.end
              comments_in_range(literal).each do |inline_comment|
                ranges << inline_comment.source_range
              end
            end

            if literal.array_type?
              opening = begin_source(literal)
              percent_types = PreferredDelimiters::PERCENT_LITERAL_TYPES
              if opening
                recognized_percent = percent_types.any? do |percent_type|
                  opening.start_with?(percent_type)
                end
                if recognized_percent
                  expression = loc.expression
                  begin_pos = expression.begin_pos
                  end_pos = expression.end_pos
                  span_length = end_pos - begin_pos
                  ignored_span = range_between(begin_pos, begin_pos + span_length)
                  ranges << ignored_span
                end
              end
            elsif literal.heredoc?
              heredoc_body = loc.heredoc_body
              ranges << heredoc_body
            elsif loc.respond_to?(:begin) && loc.begin
              expression = loc.expression
              begin_loc = loc.begin
              opening = begin_loc.source
              begin_pos = expression.begin_pos
              end_pos = expression.end_pos
              span_length = end_pos - begin_pos
              if opening.start_with?('%')
                ignored_span = range_between(begin_pos, begin_pos + span_length)
                ranges << ignored_span
              else
                ranges << expression
              end
            end
          end

          ranges
        end
        # rubocop:enable Metrics/AbcSize, Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/MethodLength, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity

        def last_line(processed_source)
          last_token = processed_source.tokens.last

          last_token ? last_token.line : processed_source.lines.length
        end

        def ignore_range?(backtick_range)
          ignored_ranges.any? { |range| range.contains?(backtick_range) }
        end

        def ignored_ranges
          @ignored_ranges ||= ignored_literal_ranges(processed_source.ast)
        end

        def no_space_style?
          cop_config['EnforcedStyle'] == 'no_space'
        end

        def space_style?
          cop_config['EnforcedStyle'] == 'space'
        end
      end
    end
  end
